left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients with chronic suppurative otitis media  [AND] with total  [OR] or subtotal tympanic membrane perforation  [AND] with limited anterior remnant

right.raw_text: -  dry perforation for at least 3 months

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Recurrent perforation after previous myringoplasty

right.raw_text: -  immune-compromised patients including uncontrolled diabetics, chronic liver  [OR] and kidney diseases
